topic: Reviewing poor sensor data quality in Finland
summary_markdown: A discussion was initiated regarding very poor data quality observed for a specific sensor in Finland (FI-HKI-MU-09021, facility 38698). The participants questioned the reliability of the sensor readings and whether a health check should be organized for the Finnish period. Concerns were raised about discrepancies in the data over time, leading to questions about the source or nature of the data issues.
decisions: No concrete decisions were made regarding immediate action.
